thread.title: iPhone display makers sink on OLED report - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Yoel Minkoff
title: iPhone display makers sink on OLED report - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) may be planning to use OLED screens for all its upcoming iPhone models, according to South Korea's Electronic Times .
At the moment, only the iPhone X uses OLED, while the iPhone 8 and iPhone 8 Plus both have LCD screens.
iPhone display makers tumbled on the report, with Japan Display ( OTCPK:JPDYY ) tumbling as much as 21% and Sharp ( OTCPK:SHCAY ) declining as much as 4.3% .
